aiRating.enSummary: Startale launched its first trust bank-backed Japanese yen stablecoin, JPYSC, this week with SBI Holdings, joined MoneyX as a platinum sponsor, launched its Layer 3 campaign, CEO Watanabe Sota will speak at the summit in April 2026, and also participated in Soneium Score Season 7.
aiRating.summary: Startale本周与SBI Holdings推出首个信托银行支持的日元稳定币JPYSC，加入MoneyX成为铂金赞助商，在Layer3启动活动，CEO WatanabeSota将在2026年4月峰会发言，还参与Soneium Score Season 7。

text:
📣 Big week for Startale

■ Startale and SBI Holdings revealed JPYSC, the first trust bank–backed JPY stablecoin.

■ Startale joined MoneyX (@WebX_Asia) today as a Platinum Sponsor, where SBI Holdings Chairman @yoshitaka_kitao shared the first public announcement of the yen-denominated stablecoin JPYSC.

■ Startale launched the Superstars Mashup campaign on @layer3 with the Startale Superstars winning teams.

■ Startale CEO @WatanabeSota will speak at the Tech for Impact Summit 2026 this April, sharing insights on “Japan Strikes Back: Web3 Rewrites the Economic Future.”

■ @soneium Score Season 7 is ongoing with the Startale App, @Arkada_gg, @capncompany, and @SakeFinance. Turn your onchain activity into a score.
